name: a1mini-petg-008-lego-v8
description: A1 mini 0.4, 0.08 mm, slow PETG walls, LEGO clutch fit, enforcer-only supports, plus ceiling recipe 8: plate sockets 2.2 mm deep, thick anchored ceiling bridges, span-cutting ribs (Seagull v8; recipe chosen from the printed v7 ceiling test). Low-cleanup variant: no brim except on parts with under 20 mm2 of bed contact, lighter support contact. Recommended PETG profile.

lego_safety.thick_bridges: 1 (safe only with ceilings recipe8: sockets are raised to 2.2 mm)

provenance: Seagull MMMB027-1 v8 (seagull/build_ceiling_v6.py + build_bridges_v8.py), CLI-verified 2026-11-11; full Seagull printed and assembled from the brickprint-built v9 file; 2026-11-11 after the full Seagull print: brim off by default, support gap 0.24->0.32 with 2 interface layers at 0.5 spacing, cone 59900 hole compensation -0.08 (confirmed on a printed test plate 2026-11-11)
